title: Amazon MSK to AWS Lambda
description: Create a Lambda function that subscribes to an MSK topic

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys a Lambda function that uses an Amazon MSK topic as an event source.

bullets.text: Using Amazon MSK as an event source for AWS Lambda

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. Publish messages to the Amazon MSK topic. Follow the steps as outlined in Step 4 to create a client machine and publish messages to the MSK Topic.
2. Retrieve the logs from the Lambda function: sam logs -n ENTER_YOUR_CONSUMER_FUNCTION_NAME.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"

authors.name: Parnab Basak
